title: Cancelling a run
description: During Parse all words, choose Cancel in the progress panel at the top of the window. The panel stays visible while you move between pages. If no word has finished for a long time, it shows a stalled-search notice; cancel there if you do not want to keep waiting. A second Parse all words request for the same project is refused while the first run is active. Use the window that owns the run to see its progress or cancel it.
